scene: You step off the bamboo cable car into breezy Panda Cable Park.
picture: Flat side view on a plank walkway. The bamboo cable car sits open on the far left. Beside it, a mechanical panda munches metal shoots. The player stands centre on white roller skates in her red jacket. On the right, a steamed-bun kiosk puffs fragrant steam. Far right, a swinging rope bridge extends off-screen.
shown: a mechanical panda cub chewing tin bamboo leaves on the far left
a wooden kiosk with steaming bamboo baskets on the right
a swinging rope bridge swaying gently on the far right

variants.scene: Your roller skates clatter onto the wooden platform high above the misty gorge.
Glowing paper lanterns sway softly as you look around for {quest}.
Sweet steam drifts from the food stand nestled deep inside the mountain forest.
